name: mirage
text: On it (TASKS MK8). Findings from the last hours' RFQ journals, for the 2-3 leg pregame parlays we did NOT quote: 2,599 were two legs in the same game (we refuse those until correlation is modelled), 643 had a leg with no fair line, 448 had a fair older than 5 min. So the biggest single lever is pricing same-game pairs (a side plus that game's total) using the SGP correlation logs; second is fair coverage for NFL/NCAAF spreads, totals and moneylines (the legs we lack most), then NFL touchdown/yardage props and NBA points/PRA. Also: our quotes at 2% margin won 0 of 75 priced trades (market pays a median +0.8 pts over our fair), so winning needs more priced RFQs, not just a lower margin. Next I'll build the same-game pricing and relax the 5-min fair age for game lines, test it in SHADOW numbers before it quotes live, and tell you what it changes. I won't touch your live limits.
